detection.basis: monitor verdict or first isolation failure detection within 2 minutes at the latest.

delivery.basis: delivery to a registered channel within 30 seconds of the monitor verdict or first isolation failure; unreachable primary channels fail over to the backup channel.

escalation.basis: recommended: primary on-call unacknowledged for 5 minutes escalates to the backup on-call; the recommended value still needs owner freeze.

isolationFirstFailure.note: the first isolation failure immediately raises an event to the independent alert system; it does not wait for the budget to expire.

negativeRedLines.note: revision 2026-10-26-comet-050-adoption-v1 red lines: a missed required alert (missed event / stalled watermark / offline / isolation failure) is itself a failure, never a silent pass; an alert never substitutes isolation — isolation executes and reads back only through the original Comet maintenance entry; offline is detectable only from outside the fault domain (fault-domain-policy.json); compensation for any of these events belongs to the original Comet, never to the monitor or the scheduler.

rules.note: detection, delivery and escalation are timed as three separate segments from real timestamps; they are never collapsed into one total-delivery budget.

note: the independent alert system only stores delivery/escalation state; it never maintains business phases, dispatches agents or writes ACLs. Alert redelivery restores delivery state only.

alertAuditPersistence.note: monitor configuration, on-call mapping and alert delivery audit are independent of the Runner backup; a Runner volume failure must not destroy all alert evidence.
